rows.name: sync-engine
rows.summary: The offline sync engine in src/sync: the offline edit queue that replays edits in order, tombstone retention for deletes, and how uploads and retries reach the server.
rows.readWhen: Changing how queued edits replay, tombstone lifetime, upload batching, retry behavior, or any function in src/sync.
conventions: Read CONSTITUTION.md (invariants §1–§4) before changing anything here.
Every sync function takes the device id as its first argument.
Edits must replay in order, sequence numbers never repeat, and the server never rewrites history.

boxes.name: offline-replay-queue
boxes.summary: src/sync/queue.ts `replay`: holds edits made offline and replays them to the server in order once the device reconnects.
boxes.readWhen: Changing replay order, queue contents, reconnect behavior, or how queued edits are sent.

boxes.name: tombstone-retention
boxes.summary: src/sync/tombstones.ts `TOMBSTONE_DAYS`: how long delete markers are kept (30 days, fixed by invariant §3) so other devices learn about deletions.
boxes.readWhen: Changing tombstone lifetime, delete propagation, or cleanup of old tombstones.

boxes.name: batched-uploads
boxes.summary: Groups queued edits into batches for upload to the server (added 2026-08-14).
boxes.readWhen: Changing batch size, upload request shape, or how batches interact with retries and rate limits.

rows.name: testing
rows.summary: How the test suite is run and the known traps when writing tests, especially sync tests.
rows.readWhen: Writing or fixing tests, setting up sync test fixtures, or debugging a test that passes locally but hides a real bug.
conventions: Sync tests use a real clock; do not mock it.
